summary: Frontend-only iteration 3 of Teologia Viva PWA. Supabase auth is NOW FIXED (iteration-2 blocker resolved): signup returns access_token + session directly; plan-badge shows 'Trial · 7d'; login/logout cycle works. All 7 protected routes correctly redirect to /auth when unauthenticated. Bible reader, book picker (38 books), prev/next nav, and 36 verses on João 3 all render correctly. Perfil shows correct email + plano. Bottom nav 5 tabs visible. HOWEVER, two NEW critical backend blockers were uncovered that break the AI + persistence flows end-to-end: (1) the clever-task Supabase Edge Function fails its CORS preflight with HTTP 500 ('Unexpected end of JSON input' — tries to JSON-parse the empty OPTIONS body), which blocks EVERY browser-originated call to it → AI Tutor (ai-tutor-send) and Explicar com IA (btn-explicar-ia + verse-explanation) cannot be used from the PWA. (2) Supabase tables return 403/404 in-browser for authenticated users: profiles upsert during signup is 403 (silently swallowed), and anotacoes INSERT fails → 'Falha ao salvar' toast, Anotação created=0. Comunidade + Eventos + Devocional empty states render but also emit 404s suggesting RLS/table-schema issues or missing rows.

critical.issue: OPTIONS preflight returns HTTP 500 {"error":"Unexpected end of JSON input"}. The Edge Function body parses JSON unconditionally and crashes on the empty OPTIONS body. Browser CORS fails → every fetch from the PWA is blocked. Confirmed via: curl -X OPTIONS $SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/clever-task -H 'Origin: https://teologia-viva.preview.emergentagent.com' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Headers: authorization,apikey,content-type'. Fix: at the top of the Deno handler, early-return for req.method==='OPTIONS' with 204 + headers {Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*', Access-Control-Allow-Headers: 'authorization, apikey, content-type', Access-Control-Allow-Methods: 'POST, OPTIONS'}. Also set those same CORS headers on the POST response.

Signup-time profiles upsert returns HTTP 403 (RLS). Anotacoes insert by authenticated user fails (404/403) → toast 'Falha ao salvar' and Anotações list stays empty after create. User.id is present and JWT is being sent by supabase-js, so this is a missing RLS policy or missing column. Recommended policies: profiles: `create policy "self upsert" on profiles for all using (auth.uid() = id) with check (auth.uid() = id);`  anotacoes: `create policy "self rw anotacoes" on anotacoes for all using (auth.uid() = user_id) with check (auth.uid() = user_id);` (plus ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and GRANT ... to authenticated).

minor.issue: Seven 404/403 errors observed on authenticated fetches against these tables. Pages render empty-state UI correctly (graceful fallback), but real data flow cannot be tested until policies/seed are applied. Most likely: RLS enabled but no policy for authenticated users, OR tables missing columns referenced in the queries (e.g., contador_oracoes, interacoes_oracao.oracao_id).

ui_bugs.issue: After opening the book picker Sheet and dismissing it with Escape, a lingering overlay continues to block subsequent bottom-nav clicks (tab-comunidade / tab-eventos click intercepted, URL stays on /biblia until the overlay fully unmounts). Users can still navigate via a second click after a second, but it is janky. Consider ensuring DialogOverlay/SheetOverlay unmounts synchronously with onOpenChange.

The fixed 'Made with Emergent' badge (id=emergent-badge) overlaps the bottom nav on 420×844 viewport and intercepts pointer events on tabs at the very right edge. Playwright reproduced this consistently (force=True needed). End users on phones with the same badge would experience the same intercept. If the badge is mandatory, raise the bottom-nav z-index above it or add bottom padding on the badge.

integration_issues.issue: btn-tutor-ia opens the drawer and ai-tutor-input accepts text, but ai-tutor-send never produces a response because the clever-task preflight fails with CORS (see backend critical #1). Likewise btn-explicar-ia fires, verse-explanation never renders. End-to-end AI flow is 100% broken from the browser.

btn-nova-anotacao opens drawer, inputs present, btn-salvar-anotacao click → toast 'Falha ao salvar' and list stays at 0 (supabase insert fails — see backend critical #2). Delete path untested because nothing could be created.

Drawer opens and all three inputs (nome/texto/publicar) are present, but publishing results in 0 new pedidos (RLS/404 on mural_oracoes). Vou-orar chain requires a pedido to exist first — untestable until insert works.

issues: Right edge of tab-eventos overlaps with the Made-with-Emergent floating pill on 420px viewport — user must tap to the left of the pill to activate the tab.

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix Supabase Edge Function clever-task CORS/OPTIONS: add `if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders })` at the top, and attach the same corsHeaders to the POST response. corsHeaders = { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, apikey, content-type, x-client-info', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS' }. Currently OPTIONS crashes with 500 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. This single fix unblocks BOTH AI Tutor and Explicar-com-IA flows.

CRITICAL — In Supabase SQL editor, enable and add RLS policies so authenticated users can CRUD their own rows in: profiles (upsert by id=auth.uid()), anotacoes (user_id=auth.uid()), mural_oracoes (insert by user_id=auth.uid(); select public), interacoes_oracao (user_id=auth.uid()), eventos_comunidade (select where status='approved'). Without these, every write silently fails and reads return 404.

Consider seeding minimal rows so QA can validate non-empty flows: 1–2 devocionais for today, 1–2 eixos + 1 curso + 1 aula, 1 mural_oracoes pedido, 1 eventos_comunidade approved event. Current empty-state UIs are correct, but end-to-end flow tests are limited without seed.
UX — Fix Biblia biblia-book-picker Sheet overlay leaking past close; users must tap twice to navigate after dismiss.
UX — Raise bottom-nav z-index above #emergent-badge so the right-most tab (Eventos) isn't intercepted by the floating pill on mobile width.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/ai.js swallows res.ok errors into a thrown Error but the UI handlers just hide the drawer without surfacing a PT-BR toast. Add toast.error('Falha ao consultar IA. Tente novamente.') on the caller catch so users know AI is unavailable instead of 'nothing happens'.

However the remove() in Anotacoes optimistically drops the item before awaiting the delete: if delete fails it calls load() but the user briefly sees the item gone then back — acceptable.

Auth.jsx still lacks an explicit branch for err.status===429 / rate limit (carry-over from iteration-2 note). Not hit this iteration, but would still regress to raw supabase-js error text if SMTP rate-limit kicks in.

Edge Function clever-task must handle OPTIONS preflight; currently it 500s and there are no CORS headers on 4xx/5xx responses either. This is the single biggest blocker today.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 state: Supabase Auth IS FIXED (signup returns session, plan-badge appears, login/logout cycle verified). Two UPSTREAM blockers remain and BOTH are outside the frontend code: (A) clever-task Edge Function returns 500 on OPTIONS preflight — curl reproduction: `curl -X OPTIONS $SUPABASE_URL/functions/v1/clever-task -H 'Origin: https://teologia-viva.preview.emergentagent.com' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Headers: authorization,apikey,content-type' -i` should return 204 with Access-Control-Allow-* headers after fix. (B) RLS missing/blocking on profiles + anotacoes + mural_oracoes — reproducible by logging in and observing 7× 403/404 in browser console. Once both are cleared, re-run: signup → plan badge → tab-biblia → verse click → btn-explicar-ia (wait 15s for verse-explanation) → aula tutor IA → comunidade create+vou-orar → anotacoes create+delete → perfil logout. Frontend URL from /app/frontend/.env: https://teologia-viva.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 420×844.
rca of the issue: Primary RCA #1 (AI completely broken): Browser CORS preflight OPTIONS request to clever-task Edge Function returns HTTP 500 with body `{"error":"Unexpected end of JSON input"}`. Confirmed by curl. Root cause: the Deno handler calls `await req.json()` unconditionally — OPTIONS has no body, so JSON parsing throws and the wrapper returns 500 without CORS headers. Because no Access-Control-Allow-Origin is present on the 500, every browser call to the function fails preflight and the actual POST never fires. Fix: at the top of the handler add `if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: corsHeaders });` and merge corsHeaders into every Response. Primary RCA #2 (data persistence broken): Supabase REST calls by the authenticated user return 403/404 on profiles.upsert, anotacoes.insert, mural_oracoes.insert. Root cause: RLS is enabled on these tables but no permissive policy exists for auth.uid()=user_id / id. The 403 is silently caught in AuthContext.signUp (synthetic profile fallback), but Anotacoes.save and Comunidade.submitPedido surface it as a PT-BR toast and the row is never created. Fix: add per-table RLS policies as described in action_items. Reproduction steps: 1) Open /auth → Criar conta → any fresh email + TestPass123. 2) Confirm redirect to / and plan-badge 'Trial · 7d'. 3) Open Bíblia → click a verse → click 'Explicar com IA' → drawer shows the verse but verse-explanation never appears (CORS failure in devtools). 4) Open /anotacoes → Nova → preencher → Salvar → toast 'Falha ao salvar'. 5) Devtools Network shows OPTIONS 500 on clever-task and 403/404 on /rest/v1/anotacoes.
